Planning directions. Confirm the proposed construction and fit through supplier review and an appropriate sample.
Consider a hinged opening for a displayed piece or set.Bring: Item layout, lid space, insert and closure preference.
Does the lid clear the complete set and close as intended?
Consider a sliding tray when the opening sequence is part of the presentation.Bring: Tray layout, sleeve clearance, pull detail and any stop.
Can the customer pull the loaded tray and remove the jewelry easily?
Consider a lift-off lid when the full set should be visible together.Bring: Usable interior, lid depth and space needed to lift the lid.
Is the lid fit comfortable, with enough room above the piece?
Plan the box and holder together when position and removal need review.Bring: Each item, clasp or post, contact surfaces and removal route.
Does the actual jewelry stay in position without obstructing removal or closure?
Consider a pouch for a handoff or as a separate part of a larger pack.Bring: Item envelope, opening, closure, seams and intended use.
Can the complete item enter and leave the pouch without unwanted contact?
